regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, one-narrative market: only Coal (rank 1) and Banks (rank 2) clear the trend gate, and rotation breadth is just 0.09. Critically, this market's backtest verdict says the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold here (mean-reverting tape), and track_record directional accuracy is 0.337 — so I am leaning low conviction and heavily conditioning anything I say on price confirmation, not the detector's momentum rank.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ, crowded=true, crowding_z=1.39, rank 6) falls out of the crowded-but-not-eligible cluster and drifts lower while Coal and Banks both stay above trend — the observable that would retire this watch is Pharma & CXO closing a week above its prior monthly high.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the lone eligible leader with a one-narrative structure and a non-crowded tape. The only reason to surface it at all is that it is the current flow-concentration in an otherwise momentum-weak, mean-reverting market, and the trend gate has it eligible. Because gate_helps is false on this market, I am NOT relying on the gate for drawdown control — this is a conditional read that Coal holds its relative leadership while the benchmark itself does not break down.
evidence: one_narrative=true, breadth=0.5 (leadership is narrow but not crowd-chased)
hurst_tag=mean-revert — consistent with the market-wide mean-revert verdict, so expect chop
theses.dissent: Coal is a mean-reverting theme by the detector's own Hurst tag, and backtest_verdict says this market whipsaws trend followers; the rank-1 momentum label has ~zero forward edge, so the most likely outcome is that Coal chops sideways or hands leadership back on the next policy/flow shift.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) drops below its 20-day moving average by the check-by date.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and rank 2 with the strongest durability_bar (0.78) and breadth (0.944) on the board, but they are crowded (crowding_z=1.74) and the rotation margin to Coal is only 0.065. I am flagging an underweight lean not as an alpha call but as a sizing caution: the crowd is already in, and a crowded rank-2 theme in a mean-reverting tape often demonstrates that leadership is too consensus to extend. This is a 'do not chase the second-place theme' read, not a short.
theses.dissent: Banks have the strongest durability and breadth in the whole universe, and that cohesion can persist in a flow-starved tape; underweighting the second-strongest eligible theme risks missing the one durable non-resource expression of value in A-shares.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) print a higher 10-day return than Coal (515220.SS) while both remain above their trends by the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
